product.name: Monoprice Select Series USB-C to Mini DisplayPort Adapter
product.description: Connect a Mini DisplayPort® display at resolutions up to 3840x2160p @60Hz to mirror your laptop's display or to expand your system's desktop area.Small and portable, you can slip the adapter into your laptop case and have it ready for use wherever and whenever the need arises.This adapter is a true Plug and Play device, with no need for drivers or software installations of any kind. Just plug the reversible USB-C™ connector into your computer's video output and connect to your DisplayPort display using DisplayPort cable (not included).This adapter is compatible with USB-C equipped laptops, such as the Apple MacBook® and Google Chromebook™.Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
